# Error code reference

Every failure is `{ok=false,error=BloxError}` with required kind, code, message, endpoint and attempts.
HTTP status is optional. Bodies are redacted; messages are not a parsing contract.
Switch on kind for cross-service behavior; code identifies a specific diagnostic.

## SDK fallback codes

| Code | Kind |
|---|---|
| `sdk_unauthorized` | `Unauthorized` |
| `sdk_forbidden` | `Forbidden` |
| `sdk_not_found` | `NotFound` |
| `sdk_conflict` | `Conflict` |
| `sdk_validation` | `Validation` |
| `sdk_rate_limited` | `RateLimited` |
| `sdk_server` | `Server` |
| `sdk_network` | `Network` |
| `sdk_timeout` | `Timeout` |
| `sdk_circuit_open` | `CircuitOpen` |
| `sdk_cancelled` | `Cancelled` |
| `sdk_local` | `Local` |

Local queue saturation is RateLimited / sdk_rate_limited with no HTTP status. Budget waits may instead
reach Timeout. Retry only eligible keyed/idempotent operations within the original deadline.
Unauthorized/Forbidden need credential/grant correction; Validation needs input correction; Conflict
needs authoritative reload/reconciliation, not a fresh key that duplicates an uncertain write.

## Domain codes

The following allowlisted backend and local validation codes are collected from source.
Recognized codes are normalized to lowercase snake_case across all services (including Auth).
Backend error text and unknown backend codes are never copied; unknown codes use the SDK fallback.
Diagnostic path/field/opIndex are bounded; service HTTP rules and the backend remain authoritative.
